description: Six transparent camping food props: raw, golden and burnt marshmallow and kebab
prompt:
Create a 3 columns by 2 rows SHEET OF SIX DIFFERENT STATIC GAME FOOD PROPS on a genuinely transparent background. Six clearly separated props in exact equal grid cells with VERY LARGE transparent gutters. No text, labels, captions, grid lines, borders, background or people.
Warm cozy hand-painted 2.5D camping game illustration, elevated oblique perspective, crisp small game inventory icons that also look good dropped on a sandy campsite. Each prop has a short simple light-brown wooden skewer angled diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, with the food at upper-right. Consistent camera angle, stick length, food size and lighting across all six. No long kebab pole.
Top-left: a fluffy raw white marshmallow on its short wooden stick. Top-middle: the SAME marshmallow, beautifully golden toasted edges, creamy center. Top-right: the SAME marshmallow comically over-toasted dark brown/black outside, intact shape, no smoke.
Bottom-left: a small uncooked camping kebab of mushroom, bell pepper and pale sausage pieces on a short wooden stick. Bottom-middle: the SAME kebab deliciously grilled with golden-brown grill marks. Bottom-right: the SAME kebab comically burnt dark brown/black, intact shape, no smoke.
Each entire prop fully inside its own equal cell; no touching props, no objects crossing cell boundaries; transparent space all around and between them. Top row all marshmallow stages, bottom row all kebab stages. A static inventory asset collection, not character animation frames. Native transparent RGBA output.
extraction: sprite-gen slice-sheet, native RGBA, alpha-floor 64, grid 3x2, sheet scale, contain fit, 256x256
